phase3_new_workflows_to_add: generator-governance-generate-script-registry.yml — mirror of generator-governance-generate-action-docs.yml but for operations/scripts/**. Triggers on push to docs-v2 when operations/scripts/** changes; runs generate-script-registry.js --write; auto-commits regenerated tools/config/registry/script-registry.json. Closes the self-documenting symmetry between actions and scripts.

phase2_blocker_d_gov_08.decision: D-GOV-08 (every folder is governed, no commit of files that do not belong)
phase2_blocker_d_gov_08.rule: Every folder hosting repo-influencing files needs the full 5-layer prevention chain (write-time hook, pre-commit, PR validator, post-merge repair, scheduled scan). Detection is fail-safe; prevention happens at layer 1.
phase2_blocker_d_gov_08.phase2_requirement: Dispatcher design must enumerate every governed folder and confirm its 5-layer chain is wired or scoped into Phase 3 before any dispatcher ships.
phase3_new_allowlists: .github/.allowlist (currently missing — root cause of recent drift)
phase2_blocker_d_gov_08.phase3_surface_registrations: Every governed folder must be registered in operations/governance/config/repo-governance-surfaces.json per D-ACT-10.

_meta.phase_1_5_summary: 30 community-contribution scripts audited. 2 run-tested works. 22 source-coherent. 6 source-needs-context. Zero broken or unclear.
